built.label: fig:pipeline-status
built.note: Stages 1 and 2 (cohort construction, medication extraction) carry no committed numeric source and are summarized in one note line rather than drawn as rows. The detector-training row's finding is categorical narrative with no committed numeric source (CORRECTIONS.md). The reported-number column otherwise reads the pharmacist base rate on G299 (0.0401, step2_signal_check.json), the weak labeller's positive rate on the same 299 gold pairs (0.8729, exp1a_gold_error_rates_by_group.json), and the decontaminated AUROC point estimate alone (0.5145, corrected_gold_metrics.json). The check-finding column reads the range of the exemplar defect rate across instruments, which no instrument establishes (C106 settles neither): 0 from the step2plus join (step2plus_results.json) to 0.9315 of decidable Rule 1/2 candidates from the unvalidated direct extractor (exemplar_direct.json); it also reads the prevalence multiplier (~22x, same gold-set ratio fig:intro-headline brackets), and the bootstrap 95% CI on AUROC ([0.32, 0.70], corrected_gold_metrics.json). The spine asserts shared corrupted input from the stage 3 exemplar defect into rows 4-6, not that rows 4-6's numbers follow causally from it: the 22x mismatch is a prevalence and specificity effect. AUROC corrected per CORRECTIONS.md C16 (was 0.460, now the decontaminated 3-seed ensemble 0.5145).

built.label: fig:cohort-flow
built.note: CONSORT-style path from the source database to the two evaluated sets. Nine stages, four exclusions, every count read from a committed file. One exclusion branch the diagram would otherwise carry is omitted because no committed file records it as a count: the admissions dropped between the length-of-stay filter and the both-roles requirement. That is a difference of two committed counts and not itself a recorded exclusion, so it is not drawn. The admissions dropped between the both-roles requirement and the selected pairs are drawn because that count is itself registered: the shortfall is entirely on the nursing side, since a both-roles admission is selectable only when some nursing note carries a chart time strictly before discharge, and the discharge side carries no matching condition. The ambiguous count is the difference between the two positive counts recorded on the same 299 rows in the signal-check file, the same subtraction the prevalence figure performs. Four stages read the thesis register rather than a primary artifact, because their own upstream summaries live outside this repository under the data agreement.
